fixer.title: Markdown Editor: don't resync the webview on dirty-state changes

cases.mechanism: Each save-related dirty-state event with no text changes redundantly triggered an O(document size) getText/full-content RPC transfer and renderer replaceSourceText; with after-delay autosave this repeated during active typing and could occur up to twice per save without coalescing.
cases.symptom: Large Markdown documents incurred repeated full-model replacement during autosave, adding IPC, allocation, and renderer work on the typing path and causing visible typing lag/caret disruption.
cases.fixedBehavior: The added contentChanges.length === 0 guard returns before diagnostics refresh, epoch invalidation, full-document RPC serialization, and renderer model replacement, while content-bearing external changes continue through the existing synchronization path.
cases.evidence: The base event listener at line 645 handled every same-document onDidChangeTextDocument event. For empty dirty-state/save events it fell through to postAuthoritativeUpdate, which reads the entire document (postAuthoritativeUpdate at current lines 435-442), sends the full content over the extension/webview RPC boundary, and the renderer handles update by constructing a StringValue and calling model.replaceSourceText (markdown-editor-src/editor.ts:190-198). The new bridge test demonstrates two saves can occur between same-epoch edits and expects zero renderer updates. Blame identifies the listener's introducing commit.
